sn12.16:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn12.16:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante dhammakathiko hotīti.
sn12.16:2.1: jarāmaraṇassa ce bhikkhu dibabidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn12.16:2.2: jarāmaraṇassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn12.16:2.3: jarāmaraṇassa ce bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn12.16:3.11: avijjāya ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn12.16:3.12: avijjāya ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hotiฃ dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn12.16:3.13: avijjāya ce bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāyāti.
